#!/bin/bash
set -e

  local branch=$1
  local target=$2

  mkdir -p "$target"
  git --git-dir="$GIT_REPO" --work-tree="$target" checkout -f "$branch" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Read the ref updates
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
  branch=$(basename "$refname")

    deploy_branch "main" "$DEPLOY_DIR"
  elif [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then
    deploy_branch "dev" "$DEPLOY_DIR/dev"

done
